product_name: PD1180-EPR — NEMA 34 Smart Motor-Mounted Stepper Controller with USB-C PD 3.1 EPR
requested_delivery: Fully populated, programmed and functionally tested PCBA for the confirmed motor/load

additional_services.shipment_acceptance: Agree provider versus receiving-team test scope; retain exact programmed-image readbacks, first-article measurements and the agreed per-board acceptance records.
additional_services.instructions: Request programming and Function Test explicitly; service availability for this board and its 48 V motor/brake test must be accepted by the provider. No order has been placed.

pcb.via_in_pad_count_basis: Finished via drill intersects an F.Paste SMD land; exact final-board SHA-256 and coordinates in rp2040-via-in-pad.json. Apply filled/capped processing to every via-in-pad and specified thermal via.

usb_impedance.copper_requirement: 1 oz outer AND inner; do not substitute a standard 0.5 oz inner stack-up

pcb.driver_top_cooling: DRV8462DDV exposed TOP: fit selected Same Sky HSB14-353518 / Ceramique 2 with supported contact at both IC ends. See thermal-qualification.md for fit and measurement requirements. Retained 1 oz copper needs its own current/thermal measurements; TI recommends 2 oz.

assembly.dnp: Do not substitute electrical values or package variants without engineering review
assembly.through_hole_and_tall_parts: Include all fitted BOM headers and bulk capacitors in the agreed assembly scope; selective/hand assembly method requires provider confirmation
assembly.optional_unpopulated_policy: U18 bottom; C52/C53 top. All three DNP, omitted from fitted BOM/CPL and paste. Rear magnet attachment unqualified.
assembly.external_motor_harness: Separate Alpha 3057 16 AWG pigtails and TE 320559 splices to WAGO 2601-3104 J2; direct clamp termination, no mating housing/contact. See motor-harness.md. Harness assembly is not automatically included in PCBA.

U3_eeprom.requirement: Program approved TI TPS26750 full-flash image and verify/read back after assembly
U3_eeprom.interface: EEP_SDA/EEP_SCL on TPS26750 I2Cc; separate from RP2040 PD_SDA/PD_SCL. Fixture access, power and bus ownership require qualification.

U16_mcu.requirement: Program the included RP2040 diagnostic image first; build separate serial-bound stationary-power and bounded-motor profiles following commissioning.md, with full readback after each programming step.
U16_mcu.commissioning_only: Included diagnostics keep motor outputs inhibited. Explicit power-test and bench-test builds use hashed board/serial prerequisite records; follow commissioning.md for local START, limits and post-assembly measurements.

functional_test.required_record: Board serial/revision, both image hashes, programming verification, qualified motor/load/settings, measured rails/PD/current/temperature/brake response, inhibit tests, operator/date and PASS/FAIL
functional_test.shipment_rule: Record programming/readback and the agreed per-board tests for each serial; identify any receiving-team commissioning stages explicitly in the delivery scope.

redesign_status: DATA-only source, firmware and native CAD verified; eight USB-hole errors and cosmetic findings remain recorded for fabricator disposition. Supplied diagnostic and bounded test profiles support post-assembly commissioning.
